row: Paradigm Health is Indiana's compassionate hospice and palliative care provider. They provide experienced and skilled end-of-life care to families throughout Indiana including: Metro Indianapolis, the Greater Ft. Wayne area, South Bend & beyond St. Joe county and as far south as Bloomington.  You get patient centered care that focuses on alleviating symptoms, caregiver stress and life enrichment services to maximize your loved ones quality of life.
